name: What should I consider when choosing a new bathroom vanity?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a new bathroom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a new bathroom vanity, consider several practical and aesthetic factors. Measure your space carefully to ensure the vanity fits without hindering movement or door swings. Think about storage needs: do you prefer drawers, cabinets, or open shelving? Material choice for the cabinet and countertop impacts durability and maintenance. Also, consider the style that complements your bathroom's overall design and your budget. Faucet compatibility and sink type (undermount, vessel) are also important decisions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider space, storage needs, materials, style, and budget when choosing a vanity. Ensure it complements your bathroom design and accommodates your faucet and sink preferences.
